transitions.label: Session start at dusk
transitions.evidence: YAML anchors April 12; u0004 says the sun is setting and u0020-u0021 describe dusk and red sunset light.

transitions.label: Sun disappears behind the mountains
transitions.evidence: u0692 describes the chapel in shadow after the sun has gone behind the mountains; u0733 still describes the setting sun.

transitions.label: Scouts return after about an hour
transitions.evidence: u0964-u0967: scouts return after slightly less than an hour; the others finish a short rest. No night's sleep or date change occurs.

transitions.label: Further watch as full darkness falls
transitions.evidence: u1165-u1167: another hour of observation is chosen, and full darkness takes hold. The sunset references are approximate, not a precise clock.

transitions.label: Carcass ritual begins during the watch
transitions.evidence: u1171 places the start roughly half an hour after sunset; u1184 describes ten to fifteen minutes per carcass.

transitions.label: Carcass work continues
transitions.evidence: u1185 describes another roughly half hour passing during the repeated work; u1204-u1206 end the observation with Wellby returning.

transitions.label: Approach at about nine at night
transitions.evidence: u1418 explicitly says it is about 9 pm and pitch black except for the fire.

transitions.label: Ten minutes extinguishing the fire
transitions.evidence: u2187-u2188 give about ten minutes to smother the fire; u2204 confirms full night.

transitions.label: Tower shelter and overnight watches
transitions.evidence: u2487 secures the party in the tower; u2511-u2518 establish watch-taking and sleep. u2507's midnight comment and u2630's 12:15 comment concern ending the real-world game, not an in-world clock.

transitions.label: Waking the next morning
transitions.evidence: u2534 describes waking after the night; u2542-u2580 resolve the rest, and u2582 explicitly confirms morning. Advancing the anchored April 12 date by one night yields April 13, matching YAML drEnd.
